usageNotes: Use this to list all Ceph MDS (Metadata Server) daemons visible from a given PVE node, including their state, rank, CephFS binding, and whether a local systemd unit is configured. Requires Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit on the root path. Only meaningful when Ceph is deployed on the cluster; nodes with no Ceph config will return an empty array.

examples.summary: List MDS daemons from node pve1

tips: A rank of -1 and no fs_name indicates a standby MDS not currently serving any CephFS.
Check the 'service' field to confirm whether the MDS systemd unit is enabled locally on that node — absence means it exists only in Ceph's cluster map.
standby_replay: true is a hot-standby (mirrors active MDS journal) and enables faster failover.
state values like 'stopped' or 'unknown' mean the daemon is configured locally but the cluster does not see it as active — check the ceph-mds@<name> systemd unit on the host.
